title: Quality columns: behaviour, coverage, calibration, work-usage
goal: Columns 5 to 8 show the quality evidence each project already stores
acceptance: Column 5: behaviour checks last run, passes, held-out regressions, runner set or not (reads the F-102-T07 stored results; absent results read unknown)
Column 6: latest coverage figure, trend against the previous figure, coverage.enforce on or off, browser coverage where used
Column 7: median actual over baseline from the work-items calibration, and re-estimation due
Column 8: workUsage on or off, last measured
Fixtures, committed failing first: one per column, with a regression, a falling trend and a missing-evidence case each flagged
privacy: Fixtures are invented repositories, manifests and API responses; no personal data, no real alert content.
escalation: A change to how an existing table, gap kind or evidence file behaves goes back to the owner
A source that cannot be read without a new token scope or a project edit is reported unknown, never worked around

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed: four readers over stored results, three small and one (coverage trend) with two readings to compare. Not a measurement.
